caption: The drawing features a wooden desk with a light brown finish. The desk is rectangular in shape, supported by four turned legs with rounded feet. The front of the desk includes a single wide drawer, centrally located, with two circular wooden knobs. On the back edge of the desktop, there is a raised backboard that spans the width of the desk. The desk is depicted against a plain, light background with no other objects or patterns, and the text "SHAKER DESK" is written below the desk in small, capital letters. The composition centers the desk in the image, showcasing its simple and functional design.
title: Shaker Desk
